summary: TTM Technologies filed an 8-K after completing a $500 million private placement of 6.750% senior unsecured notes due 2034, priced at par, interest payable semi-annually beginning April 1, 2027. Proceeds, plus $300 million incremental term loan A and $800 million incremental term loan B, fund the previously announced purchase of EDS Intermediate Holding, LLC and a Swiss Technology Group AG acquisition, plus general corporate purposes. Notes are guaranteed by subsidiary guarantors and rank pari passu with existing 4.000% senior notes due 2029, effectively subordinated to secured facilities. Watch acquisition closing timing and leverage.
